messages:
ida: Quick note: I'm assembling a small docs PR to tidy up Optimize samples — adding a TypeScript SDK vignette showing batching + prefix cache + a compact quant profile, and cleaning a couple of stale links. Will keep it short and copy-paste friendly. @marco @tess can you eyeball?
marco: Yep, paste the TS snippet here and I'll check for naming and minimal comments. Also make sure we call out the latency tradeoff for batch sizes.
ida: TS draft (to go under docs/examples/sdk/ts):
```ts
import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood-ai/sdk'
const c = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY })
const out = await c.generate({ model: 'redwood/compact-ts-1', input: 'Summarize in one sentence.', batching: { max_batch_tokens: 600 }, cache: { mode: 'prefix', max_prefix_kv: 2048 }, quant_profile: 'q4_0_small' })
console.log(out.text)
```
tess: Looks clean. Two tiny nits: 1) add a one-line comment about prefer-speed vs prefer-quality for that profile; 2) mention that `max_batch_tokens=600` is a latency-friendly default.
marco: CI already flagged `/optimize/old-anchors/quant` in main. I'll add a redirect to `/optimize/quantization/profiles` and run grep for other broken anchors. I can push the redirect to your branch if you want.
ida: Please push it, thanks. I'll include a one-line migration checklist in the guide: "Replace any /optimize/old-anchors/quant links with /optimize/quantization/profiles and verify profile names in your deployment manifests."
chloe: Can we add a tiny smoke test (2 prompts) and a linkcheck run to the PR checklist? That keeps things safe. I'll add that to the PR template comment.
ida: Added the smoke tests and linkcheck steps. Plan: open PR with snippet, redirect, one-line migration note, and smoke tests. ETA today.
docs-bot: PR opened by ida: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1422> (docs: optimize - ts snippet + redirects + smoke tests)
marco: Running linkcheck locally now. Will report status.
docs-bot: linkcheck finished: redirects applied, 0 remaining dead links. Smoke tests passed (2). Staging deploy started.
ida: Staging looks good, merging after one approval. Thanks everyone for quick help. :thumbsup:
